findings.passage: I am a military veteran and a gun owner, and I support the Second Amendment.
findings.note: States he owns guns and supports the Second Amendment.

findings.passage: I support the right of law-abiding Utahns to own firearms.
findings.note: Summary line of his position on gun ownership.

findings.passage: If the state seeks to restrict a person’s access to firearms, the burden belongs to the government.
findings.note: Says government must carry the burden when restricting gun access.
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: When there is compelling evidence that someone presents an immediate danger to themselves or others, I support narrowly tailored judicial intervention—
findings.note: Supports narrow court-ordered removal of guns in an immediate danger, with due-process safeguards (sworn evidence, judge review, quick full hearing, appeal, return of firearms).
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: Any emergency process must require sworn and specific evidence.
findings.note: Sets conditions for any emergency gun-removal process.

findings.passage: I support voluntary training, hunter education, community partnerships, and programs that make safety information accessible without treating gun owners as suspects.
findings.note: Backs voluntary safety training, not mandatory.

findings.passage: Utah should expand access to free or reduced-cost gun locks, lockboxes, safes, and secure vehicle-storage options.
findings.note: Backs expanded access to storage devices.

findings.passage: I support serious investigation and prosecution of firearm trafficking, straw purchasing, theft rings, and anyone who knowingly provides firearms to a prohibited person.
findings.note: Backs enforcement against trafficking and straw purchases.
